customManagers.description: The integration gate and the live TLS fixture name the PostgreSQL image in one variable each; CI and the replica stack are read by the github-actions and docker-compose managers (IF-263).

packageRules.description: The toolchain action is addressed by the Rust version its tag names; the regex manager above reads that tag, so it stays version-pinned instead of digest-pinned.
Keep local/CI Rust pins and the official Docker builder image in one toolchain update.

The gate, CI, the live TLS fixture and the replica stack run one PostgreSQL major tag and move to the next major together. A tag, not a digest: patch releases still arrive unpinned, as IF-167 decided (IF-263).

The ZIP preflight (src/util/zip_preflight) must select the same end record as these readers. Every update needs the re-read in docs/SECURITY.md (Archive reader updates); the repository policy test fails until scripts/reviewed_archive_readers.json names the new version (IF-218).
prBodyNotes: Archive reader update: before merging, do the re-read in `docs/SECURITY.md` (Archive reader updates), record it in the issue registry and update `scripts/reviewed_archive_readers.json`. CI fails until that file names the new version.
